title: A superseded event round must hand its payload to the next round
rule: When a store handles events with a 'newest round wins' guard (a counter that makes older async rounds return early), the newer round must also process what the dropped rounds were about: keep the ids of every unfinished round in a shared set, let each round work from the whole set, and clear it only when a round finishes as the newest. Add a test that fires two events in different groups without awaiting between them and asserts both are applied.
rationale: E5.10 (#73): `refreshActivation` in the library store returned early when a second `activationChanged` arrived and refetched only the second event's families, so the first family's style rows kept announcing 'not active'.
